verdict.rationale: Synctera is an API-first banking platform. Its documented API-key access lets you call the APIs programmatically right away in Sandbox, and it publishes an OpenAPI spec and sandbox test cases, so it can be driven headlessly by automation. Nothing in the evidence addresses CI specifically, such as a CLI, CI integration guides or non-interactive credential handling. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-specific tooling, documented CI/pipeline usage patterns, and independent or hands-on corroboration of automated headless use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
